Facts below were profiled read-only from the live `dw` database (schema + data
statistics only). They are facts about the data, not query instructions.
- Date-like columns are STRING typed with format 'DD-MON-YY' (e.g. '01-FEB-10').
  MIN/MAX/ORDER BY on them is LEXICOGRAPHIC, not chronological.
- Term codes are strings like '2022FA' (year + FA/SP/SU/JA). ACADEMIC_YEAR-style
  columns are numeric years.
- Some text columns contain the literal string 'nan' as a missing-value marker
  (distinct from NULL); flagged per table below.
- Many *_KEY/*_CODE/*_ID columns are non-unique; joining on them multiplies rows.
  Per-table "fan-out" notes give rows-per-distinct-value for such columns.
